# Theory: Local Users are Passwords; RBAC is Casbin Strings

Creating a login and granting a role are two operations. `p` lines are permissions; `g` lines are group membership. Projects scope which repos and clusters an app may use.

## Invariants

1. SSO (Dex) maps external identity into the same RBAC.
2. Project is a hard sandbox (source repos, destinations).
3. CLI tokens are users too.

```text
account  +  p, g lines  +  project  =  what you may sync
```

## What can break

- Admin in `policy.csv` and SSO both on, conflicting.

## How to read this chapter

Creating a user, p/g, verifying grants.
